description: Боярська міська рада: water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Боярська міська рада. Coverage: Боярська міська рада. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Правила приймання стічних вод на очисні споруди біологічної очистки КП; Правила користування водозабірними спорудами для задоволення питних, п; Порядок приєднання об’єктів з інших населених пунктів до комунальних м. Formats seen: DOC, DOCX, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
